content.text: The successful completion of this ticket will result in the currently produced artifacts:

@awoods, checked the jetty-console-maven-plugin help, it is said that "This plugin creates a jar embedding Jetty and a webapp". So can I just define the parameter "destinationFile" as <destinationFile>${project.build.directory}${file.separator}${project.artifactId}
console.jar</destinationFile> to replace the default destinationFile. This way, it produces the jetty-console.jar instead of jetty-console.war.
Also, can you point me to the jetty-console-maven-plugin help you referenced?
would like to add the line after line #311. I tested the generated jar, seems work.
Both PRs have been merged with their respective master branches:
Currently the one-click artifacts (fcrepo4 and fcrepo-message-consumer) are created as war files.
